# What is a .razor File?


A `.razor` file is a **Blazor component file** that combines C# code and HTML markup in a single file. It's similar to how:

- **Flutter** uses `.dart` files that mix widgets and logic
- **React** uses JSX to mix JavaScript and HTML
- **Vue** uses Single File Components (SFC)

```
┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
│         .razor File Structure         │
├───────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                       │
│  ┌───────────────────────────────┐    │
│  │   Directives (@page, etc.)    │    │
│  └───────────────────────────────┘    │
│                                       │
│  ┌───────────────────────────────┐    │
│  │   HTML Markup with C#         │    │
│  │   (using @ syntax)            │    │
│  └───────────────────────────────┘    │
│                                       │
│  ┌───────────────────────────────┐    │
│  │   @code { ... }               │    │
│  │   C# Logic & Properties       │    │
│  └───────────────────────────────┘    │
│                                       │
└───────────────────────────────────────┘
```


## The `@` Syntax (Razor Syntax)


The `@` symbol is the **transition character** that tells Blazor: "switch from HTML to C# code". It's the key to mixing C# and HTML seamlessly.


### Categories of `@` Syntax


```
@ Syntax Types
│
├── Directives (configuration)
│   ├── @page
│   ├── @rendermode
│   ├── @attribute
│   ├── @inject
│   └── @using
│
├── Code Blocks
│   ├── @code { }
│   └── @functions { }
│
├── Control Flow
│   ├── @if / @else
│   ├── @foreach
│   ├── @for
│   ├── @while
│   └── @switch
│
└── Expressions (inline C#)
    ├── @variable
    ├── @method()
    └── @(complex expression)
```


## Common `@` Directives


### 1. `@page` - Define Route

```razor
@page "/counter"
@page "/counter/{InitialValue:int}"
```

Defines the URL route for this component (like routing in Flutter's Navigator or React Router).


### 2. `@rendermode` - Set Rendering Mode

```razor
@rendermode InteractiveServer
@rendermode InteractiveWebAssembly
@rendermode InteractiveAuto
```

Determines how the component runs (server-side, client-side WebAssembly, or auto).


### 3. `@code` - Define C# Logic

```razor
@code {
    private int count = 0;
    
    private void IncrementCount()
    {
        count++;
    }
}
```

Contains C# fields, properties, methods - like the Dart code in a Flutter StatefulWidget.


### 4. `@inject` - Dependency Injection

```razor
@inject HttpClient Http
@inject NavigationManager NavManager
```

Injects services (similar to Flutter's Provider or GetIt).


### 5. `@attribute` - Add Attributes to Component

```razor
@attribute [Authorize]
@attribute [StreamRendering]
```


## Control Flow Examples


### `@if` / `@else`

```razor
@if (isLoading)
{
    <p>Loading...</p>
}
else if (data == null)
{
    <p>No data found</p>
}
else
{
    <p>Data: @data</p>
}
```


### `@foreach`

```razor
<ul>
    @foreach (var item in items)
    {
        <li>@item.Name - @item.Price.ToString("C")</li>
    }
</ul>
```


### `@for`

```razor
@for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
{
    <div>Item @i</div>
}
```


## Inline C# Expressions


```razor
<!-- Simple variable -->
<p>Count: @count</p>

<!-- Method call -->
<p>Time: @DateTime.Now.ToString("HH:mm:ss")</p>

<!-- Complex expression (use parentheses) -->
<p>Total: @(price * quantity * 1.07)</p>

<!-- Property access -->
<p>Name: @user.FirstName @user.LastName</p>
```


## Complete Example


```razor
@page "/products"
@rendermode InteractiveServer
@inject HttpClient Http

<h3>Product List</h3>

@if (isLoading)
{
    <p><em>Loading products...</em></p>
}
else if (products == null || !products.Any())
{
    <p>No products available.</p>
}
else
{
    <div class="product-grid">
        @foreach (var product in products)
        {
            <div class="product-card">
                <h4>@product.Name</h4>
                <p>Price: @product.Price.ToString("C")</p>
                <button @onclick="() => AddToCart(product)">
                    Add to Cart
                </button>
            </div>
        }
    </div>
}

<p>Total items in cart: @cartCount</p>

@code {
    private List<Product> products = new();
    private bool isLoading = true;
    private int cartCount = 0;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        // Load data when component initializes
        products = await Http.GetFromJsonAsync<List<Product>>("api/products");
        isLoading = false;
    }

    private void AddToCart(Product product)
    {
        cartCount++;
        // Add cart logic here
    }

    public class Product
    {
        public string Name { get; set; }
        public decimal Price { get; set; }
    }
}
```


## Key Concepts Summary


```
Razor Syntax Flow
─────────────────

HTML Mode (default)
    ↓
    @ symbol detected
    ↓
C# Mode (evaluate expression)
    ↓
    Return to HTML Mode
```

- **`@` alone**: Switch to C# for a single expression
- **`@{ }` block**: Multi-line C# code block
- **`@if`, `@foreach`, etc.**: Control structures
- **`@code { }`**: Component's class members
- **Directives**: Start with `@` at the top of file for configuration

Think of `.razor` files as a **component blueprint** where you can seamlessly mix markup and logic, similar to how you'd build a Widget in Flutter with its build method and state!
